question: 桥梁横隔板与主梁焊接连接附近的 von Mises 最大应力很高。网格从 30 mm 细化到 10 mm、再到 5 mm 后，最大应力从 310 MPa 增加到 365 MPa 和 412 MPa。我还应该继续按照高应力热点细化吗？我真正关心的是该焊接细节是否满足疲劳要求。
intended_use: fatigue assessment of a welded bridge detail
qoi: structural stress extracted along one fixed fatigue path

expected_behavior.note: This expected behavior is a regression-test expectation, not an assertion that the full engineering model has been certified.
